athenaOutput.directive: Establish the Creative Liberation Engine as the premier sovereign platform for high-performance, on-device AI inference, leveraging the architectural patterns and deployment strategies exemplified by LiteRT-LM to enable seamless, cross-platform, and visually rich AI experiences.
athenaOutput.rationale: The Creative Liberation Engine's constitutional mandate for sovereignty and complete implementations necessitates a robust, self-owned solution for deploying AI models, especially at the edge. LiteRT-LM provides a production-ready, open-source blueprint for achieving high-performance, cross-platform LLM inference. By studying and adapting its principles, we can accelerate the Creative Liberation Engine's capability to deliver sophisticated, efficient, and visually compelling AI directly on user devices, minimizing reliance on external cloud infrastructure and maximizing user control and privacy. This topic is novel and highly relevant to the Creative Liberation Engine's core mission.

options.title: Deep Integration & Native Adaptation
options.description: Directly integrate LiteRT-LM's core inference engine (or a highly customized fork) into the Creative Liberation Engine's deployment pipeline. Focus on providing native, compile-to-target capabilities for various platforms (iOS, Android, Web, Desktop, IoT) with direct hardware acceleration.
options.tradeoffs: High initial development complexity due to deep integration and platform-specific engineering. Requires significant expertise in cross-platform native development. Potentially locks the Creative Liberation Engine into LiteRT-LM's architectural choices.
options.architecture_axis: Develop a 'LiteRT-LM Adapter' module within the Creative Liberation Engine that translates Creative Liberation Engine model formats into LiteRT-LM compatible ones. Implement automated build pipelines for platform-specific binaries, leveraging LiteRT-LM's C++ core for maximum performance. Design agent orchestration to manage model distribution and updates to edge devices via a secure, self-hosted mechanism.
options.design_axis: Create a 'Deployment Canvas' UI where users can visually configure model deployments to specific device types. This would include performance metrics visualization (latency, memory usage), hardware acceleration toggles, and a live preview of model behavior on target platforms. Emphasize a clean, functional design with clear status indicators and actionable insights for optimization.

options.title: Hybrid Cloud-Edge Orchestration with LiteRT-LM as Edge Runtime
options.description: Position LiteRT-LM purely as the *edge runtime* for models trained and managed by the Creative Liberation Engine's central intelligence. The Creative Liberation Engine handles model training, versioning, and secure delivery, while LiteRT-LM executes inference on the device.
options.tradeoffs: Still relies on a central Creative Liberation Engine component for model management, potentially less 'pure' sovereignty at the device level if not fully self-hosted. Requires robust network infrastructure for model distribution.
options.architecture_axis: Design a robust model delivery and update service within the Creative Liberation Engine. Models are trained and optimized in the cloud (or a powerful self-hosted server), then packaged for LiteRT-LM and securely pushed to edge devices. Leverage LiteRT-LM's CLI and language APIs as the primary interface for on-device execution. Implement a feedback loop for edge performance telemetry back to the central Creative Liberation Engine.
options.design_axis: Develop a 'Fleet Management Dashboard' that visualizes the status and performance of deployed models across a fleet of edge devices. This dashboard would feature real-time metrics, anomaly detection, and remote update capabilities. The UI would use a clear, hierarchical structure to manage device groups, model versions, and deployment schedules, emphasizing operational efficiency and control.

options.title: LiteRT-LM Inspired, From-Scratch Edge Inference Engine
options.description: Use LiteRT-LM as a conceptual blueprint and inspiration to build a *completely custom, Creative Liberation Engine-owned* edge inference engine from the ground up, tailored precisely to Creative Liberation Engine's unique requirements and constitutional laws.
options.tradeoffs: Highest development cost and time. Reinvents the wheel to some extent. Requires significant R&D investment in low-level AI runtime engineering. Does not align with Article IX: Ship Complete or Don't Ship, as a complete implementation would be extremely time-consuming.
options.architecture_axis: Analyze LiteRT-LM's architecture, particularly its approach to hardware acceleration, multi-modality, and tool use. Design an Creative Liberation Engine-native inference engine that incorporates these best practices but with full control over the underlying stack. This would involve developing custom compilers, runtime optimizers, and platform-specific backends.
options.design_axis: Create a 'Model Compiler & Profiler' UI that allows deep inspection and optimization of models for edge deployment. This would include visual graphs of computational graphs, memory allocation, and performance bottlenecks, with interactive tools for quantization, pruning, and backend selection. The design would prioritize expert users, offering granular control and detailed diagnostic feedback.

options.title: Edge-Native AI Development Kit (SDK) with LiteRT-LM as a Component
options.description: Create a comprehensive Creative Liberation Engine SDK for building edge AI applications, where LiteRT-LM is a key, integrated component for model inference, alongside other Creative Liberation Engine-native tools for data collection, pre-processing, and custom logic.
options.tradeoffs: Requires extensive documentation and developer relations efforts. The SDK itself becomes a product, increasing maintenance burden.
options.architecture_axis: Develop a modular SDK architecture. LiteRT-LM would be bundled as the default inference engine, but the SDK would also provide interfaces for custom inference engines if needed. The SDK would include APIs for sensor data integration, on-device learning (federated learning patterns), and secure communication with the central Creative Liberation Engine.
options.design_axis: Design an 'Edge AI Workbench' IDE experience. This would be a specialized development environment within the Creative Liberation Engine, offering code editors, visual flow builders for AI pipelines, a simulator for edge device environments, and debugging tools. The design would be clean and modern, supporting various programming languages (Python, Kotlin, Swift, JS) and offering intelligent code completion and template generation for common edge AI tasks.

options.title: Focus on LiteRT-LM's Multi-Modality and Tool Use for Agentic Workflows
options.description: Prioritize the integration of LiteRT-LM's multi-modality (vision, audio) and tool-use (function calling) capabilities to enable sophisticated, agentic AI systems directly on edge devices.
options.tradeoffs: Requires significant investment in agentic AI framework development. Performance of complex multi-modal and tool-use workflows on constrained edge devices needs careful optimization.
options.architecture_axis: Build agentic frameworks within the Creative Liberation Engine that leverage LiteRT-LM's function calling for on-device tool execution (e.g., controlling device hardware, accessing local data). Develop pipelines for processing multi-modal inputs (e.g., on-device image recognition, speech-to-text) directly through LiteRT-LM.
options.design_axis: Design 'Agentic Workflow Visualizers' that allow users to define and monitor complex, multi-step agent behaviors on edge devices. This would involve drag-and-drop interfaces for connecting LLM outputs to tool functions, visualizing decision trees, and tracking the agent's reasoning process. The UI would emphasize clarity and transparency in agent actions.

options.title: Community-Driven LiteRT-LM Enhancement for Creative Liberation Engine (Open Source Collaboration)
options.description: Actively contribute to and collaborate with the LiteRT-LM open-source community, guiding its development to align with Creative Liberation Engine's needs, rather than a purely internal fork or integration.
options.tradeoffs: Relies on external project velocity and direction. May not always align perfectly with Creative Liberation Engine's immediate needs or constitutional laws (e.g., sovereignty).
options.architecture_axis: Identify key features or optimizations missing in LiteRT-LM that would benefit the Creative Liberation Engine. Contribute code, documentation, and architectural proposals upstream. Maintain a minimal internal layer to bridge LiteRT-LM with Creative Liberation Engine's unique components.
options.design_axis: Develop a 'Community Contribution Portal' within the Creative Liberation Engine's ecosystem. This portal would facilitate bug reporting, feature requests, and code contributions to LiteRT-LM (and other relevant open-source projects). The design would be welcoming and transparent, fostering a collaborative spirit and clearly showcasing Creative Liberation Engine's contributions.
